movement_regime.name: Follow Vehicle
movement_regime.description: Maintain safe longitudinal headway behind lead vehicle.

movement_regime.name: Stop
movement_regime.description: Stable deceleration to a complete stationary state (v = 0).

movement_regime.name: Yield
movement_regime.description: Relinquish right-of-way by decelerating or stopping.

movement_regime.name: Change Lane
movement_regime.description: Lateral shift into an adjacent parallel travel lane.

movement_regime.name: Abort Lane Change
movement_regime.description: Cancel lateral transition and return to original lane.

movement_regime.name: Pass
movement_regime.description: Overtake a slower vehicle via adjacent lane acceleration.

movement_regime.name: Abort Pass
movement_regime.description: Cancel overtaking maneuver and return behind lead vehicle.

movement_regime.name: Turn
movement_regime.description: Transition between connecting roadways (Left, Right, U-Turn).

movement_regime.name: Shift Within Lane
movement_regime.description: Lateral nudge without crossing lane boundaries.

movement_regime.name: Shift Outside of Lane
movement_regime.description: Partial or full wheel encroachment over line.

movement_regime.name: Transition to MRC (Handover)
movement_regime.description: Transfer control to fallback human driver.

meta_actions.name: Follow Vehicle
meta_actions.description: Implement lateral and/or longitudinal control actions to maintain a safe following distance from an immediate lead vehicle, while continuing to follow the current lane of travel.

meta_actions.name: Accelerate
meta_actions.description: Implement longitudinal control actions to increase speed, as appropriate and lawful.

meta_actions.name: Decelerate
meta_actions.description: Implement longitudinal control actions to decrease speed, as appropriate.

meta_actions.name: Stop
meta_actions.description: Implement longitudinal control actions to decelerate in a safe and stable manner to a complete stop.

meta_actions.name: Yield
meta_actions.description: Relinquish right-of-way to another road user, including decelerating or stopping as required by traffic regulations or safety etiquette.

meta_actions.name: Change Lane
meta_actions.description: Implement longitudinal and/or lateral control actions to shift into an adjacent lane.

meta_actions.name: Abort Lane Change
meta_actions.description: Cancel the maneuver to shift into an adjacent lane (remain in or return to original lane).

meta_actions.name: Pass
meta_actions.description: Implement longitudinal and/or lateral control actions to shift into an adjacent lane to accelerate to desired speed and overtake another vehicle.

meta_actions.name: Abort Pass
meta_actions.description: Cancel maneuver to shift into an adjacent lane (remain in or return to original lane).

meta_actions.name: Turn
meta_actions.description: Implement lateral and longitudinal control actions to transition from current road/lane to connecting road/lane (includes parameterizations for left, right, and U-turns).

meta_actions.name: Shift Within Lane
meta_actions.description: Implement lateral and/or longitudinal control actions such that the ADS does not follow the center (or near-center) of the current lane but remains fully within the current lane.

meta_actions.name: Shift Outside of Lane
meta_actions.description: Implement lateral and/or longitudinal control actions such that the ADS partially or fully moves outside of the current lane of travel (i.e., one or more wheels cross the lane boundary).

meta_actions.name: Move Out of Travel Lane/Park
meta_actions.description: Implement lateral and longitudinal control actions such that the ADS fully exits the current active lane of travel onto a shoulder or parking lane and stops.

meta_actions.name: Transition to MRC: Return Control to Fallback-Ready User
meta_actions.description: Return longitudinal and lateral control to human occupant/driver (while providing sufficient advance warning).

meta_actions.name: Transition to MRC: ADS Implements Minimal Risk Maneuver
meta_actions.description: Implement lateral and/or longitudinal control actions to achieve a minimal risk condition automatically without reliance on human driver takeover.

meta_actions.name: Reverse / Back Up
meta_actions.description: Implement reverse gear longitudinal and lateral control actions to move the vehicle backward safely while monitoring rear blind-spot hazards (grounded in Vienna Convention Art. 14/25, Texas Code Sec. 545.415, and NHTSA Pre-Crash Scenarios 8, 15, 33-35).
